incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 502/504 rate observed at api-edge (us-west-2). 5xx spike started ~2m ago. 502s ~11% of requests for the last 1m. Graph: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/edge/edge-5xx?panelId=4
Jin (oncall): on it, acknowledging. collecting logs and checking ingress LB health.
Priya (sre): I'm looking at ingress-nginx metrics, seeing increased upstream timeouts to apigw-backend, lots of 502 from proxy -> upstream keepalive resets.
Maya (edge-lead): @Jin @Priya call this a potential routing/backpressure issue — check if we hit a connection limit on edge-proxy. Also check regional spike, any EU/APAC differences.
Jin (oncall): running quick checks: `kubectl -n edge get pods -l app=edge-proxy` -> some pods OOMkilled in the last 10m, restarting. tail-ing pod logs now.
Priya (sre): curl health on upstream apigw: `for p in $(kubectl -n apigw get pods -o name); do kubectl -n apigw exec $p -- curl -sS -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/health; done` -> all healthy 200. So upstream app is healthy, proxy side showing resets.
Maya (edge-lead): possible connection exhaustion or too-aggressive keepalive/conn reuse. Quick mitigation: enable additional edge-proxy replicas, and temporarily increase `proxy_read_timeout` and `proxy_connect_timeout`. Also route a small % to secondary region as fallback.
Marco (platform): spinning up 3 extra edge-proxy pods in us-west-2 now (scaling to +3). `kubectl -n edge scale deploy/edge-proxy --replicas=10` executed.
Jin (oncall): increased `proxy_read_timeout` to 120s on the active config and rolled it to 50% via canary. Applied config: ```nginx
proxy_connect_timeout 10s;
proxy_read_timeout 120s;
proxy_send_timeout 120s;
keepalive_timeout 65s;
```
Priya (sre): also enabled conn tracking backoff: set `max_conns_per_upstream` to 1024 on the proxy to avoid immediate resets. Rolling 100% now.
incidents-bot: NOTE: automated slow-start routing detected 8% of traffic now shifted to secondary region (us-west-1) as fallback policy.
Jin (oncall): running `tcpdump` on edge-proxy -> seeing lots of `RST` from proxy to upstream when upstream responds slowly. Suggest adding a short circuit-breaker to fail fast for unhealthy upstream nodes.
Maya (edge-lead): new plan: 1) scale edge-proxy; 2) increase timeouts; 3) enable circuit-breaker -> failover to secondary region for affected routes; 4) monitor customer impact and error rate. Execute steps 1-3 now.
Marco (platform): circuit-breaker rule pushed to route config: ```json
{"circuit_breakers": {"apigw-upstream": {"maxFailures": 5, "perHost": true, "resetIntervalMs": 10000}}}
``` deployed via config-service.
Priya (sre): rolling that out. Also started capturing tail logs with `kubectl -n edge logs -l app=edge-proxy -f --since=5m` -> uploading filtered logs to /tmp/edge-502-dump.log.
Jin (oncall): quick customer impact: 11% errors are concentrated on POST /v1/generate for customers on us-west-2. Top affected customers: acct-512 (high), acct-78 (medium). No billing spikes noticed. Sending heads-up to customer-success.
Maya (edge-lead): @pagerduty-bot please page Platform oncall for deeper kernel/socket limits check.
pagerduty-bot: Paging Platform oncall (Marco) — acknowledged. ETA 5m.
Marco (platform): checking host level: connection tracking (nf_conntrack) nearing max on some nodes, bumped sysctl `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` from 262144 -> 524288 on edge nodes, applying via ansible now.
Priya (sre): after scaling + timeouts + conntrack bump, 5xx rate dropped from 11% -> 3.2% over last 2m. Request latency normalized.
incidents-bot: Incident metric update: 5xx rate 3.2% (1m avg). Severity: elevated, customer-visible, ongoing mitigation.
Jin (oncall): I'm going to keep monitoring for 15m. If stable, plan to roll back canary changes (timeouts) to normal config gradually.
Maya (edge-lead): good. Also we need a short postmortem action item: harden conntrack/autoscale behavior and better backpressure in proxy when upstream resets.
Priya (sre): creating an incident ticket INS-2026-3290 with initial timeline and runbook links.
Jin (oncall): handing off to Priya for the next 30m — summary: 502/504 spike caused by connection exhaustion + aggressive timeouts on edge-proxy; mitigations applied: scaled proxies, increased timeouts, bumped conntrack, enabled circuit-breaker and regional fallback; customer impact limited to ~11% at peak, now ~3%.
Priya (sre): taking over monitoring. If anyone sees regression, ping me. Final note to support: sent note to CS with affected customers and ETA for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Maya (edge-lead): thanks team. filing follow-ups: adjust default proxy timeouts, add conntrack health check, autoscale based on connmetrics.
incidents-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Close conditions: 5xx < 1% for 30m and no OOM/restarts on edge-proxy pods.
